shortdesc.ph: Occurs when the SDK requests the maximum size of metadata.
Occurs when the SDK requests the maximum size of metadata.

section.p: After you successfully call registerMediaMetadataObserver:withType:, this callback is triggered each time the SDK sends a video frame. Specify the maximum metadata size in the return value of this callback.

After you successfully call registerMediaMetadataObserver:withType:, this callback is triggered each time the SDK sends a video frame. Specify the maximum metadata size in the return value of this callback.

section.title: Return Values
section.p: If the method call succeeds, returns the maximum size, in bytes, of the metadata buffer that you want to use. The maximum value is 1024 bytes.
